page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.t6-c1m4.large is a burstable instance type powered by an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor. This x86_64 architecture server features 2 virtual CPUs and 2 physical cores operating at a clock speed of 2.5 GHz. It is equipped with 8.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced 4.0 GB of RAM per core. The instance operates on a KVM hypervisor and does not include local storage or dedicated GPU hardware.

Performance benchmarks place this instance in the lower tier of cloud compute resources. Single-core stress-ng CPU performance is measured at 1161.28, while multi-core performance reaches 2371.48, both categorized as weak. Memory bandwidth is also constrained, with uncached large-block reads registering at 22.38 GB/sec and writes at 19.14 GB/sec. These metrics reflect the burstable CPU allocation model, which is designed for workloads that experience occasional spikes rather than sustained high-utilization demands.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the ecs.t6-c1m4.large offers a budget-friendly entry point by trading off sustained performance for lower resource costs. The lack of bundled local storage and baseline network bandwidth of 0 Gbps further emphasizes its positioning as a minimal-overhead utility instance. It is best suited for low-traffic web serving, development and testing environments, code repositories, and light background tasks that do not require continuous high-throughput compute or memory performance.
